title: Austin: Civic Center & Economic Vision
summary:
*   Received a progress report on the ongoing Civic Center Project.
*   Reviewed a new business plan for economic development and international trade.
*   Appointed two new members to the Private Industry Council.
transcript:

Austin City Council

APRIL 26, 1988 3:00 P.M
CENTRAL LIBRARY
Mayor Cooksey called to order the meeting of the Council, noting the absence of Mayor Pro
Tem Trevino, Councilmembers Nofziger and Shipman.
WORKSESSION
GILBANE UPDATE
Walt Marquardt, Gilbane, presented the update on the Civic Center Project.
CITY MANAGER REPORT
Joe James presented the City Manager report on Economic Development and International
Trade Department Business Plan.
PRIVATE INDUSTRY COUNCIL APPOINTMENTS
The Council, on Councilmember Urdy's motion, Mayor Cooksey's second appointed Ted Hudson
and Al Cummings as members of the Private Industry Council.
ADJOURNMENT
Council adjourned its meeting at 4:15 Ρ.Μ. -
